subject: Compact KMS rotation trace + transit encryption proof package
messages:
From: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@clearline.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Mathur <priya.mathur@krypton-audit.com>, security@clearline.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: KMS/HSM compact evidence ask for SIG+SOC2 review

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Our security team is moving through the SIG/SOC2 checklist and we need a compact evidence package focused on encryption and key management. To keep the scope narrow, can you provide the following in a single bundle (one zip or Drive folder) by Monday EOD PST: 

- KMS key rotation trace (last 12 months) in machine-readable format (CSV or JSON) including key id, rotate_timestamp, operator_id, reason
- HSM attestation/certificate (FIPS / vendor attestation) used by Redwood for protected keys
- Transit encryption cipher inventory for public-facing endpoints (TLS versions, cipher suites, mutual TLS notes)
- Short runbook that describes how rotate -> revoke -> emergency-eviction is executed (1-2 pages)

We prefer a compact set (artifact stubs + a short readme). If you have a sample export that redacts operator emails but preserves operator-id mapping, that's ideal for our auditors. 

CC'ing Priya (audit) and our security inbox. Let me know ETA.

Best,
Aaron
Security Manager, Clearline Financial

Attachments: none
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@clearline.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Priya Mathur <priya.mathur@krypton-audit.com>, security@clearline.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM compact evidence ask for SIG+SOC2 review

Aaron / Priya,

Thanks — we can get that to you Monday, and I agree a compact bundle is the right approach. High-level plan:

- Ben will export a 12-month rotation trace and scrub PII (we will replace operator emails with stable operator_id values). Format: CSV + README explaining headers.
- Marissa will pull the latest HSM attestation (vendor-signed PDF) and a one-page runbook excerpt describing rotation & emergency-eviction flow.
- I'll produce a short transit cipher inventory (current TLS/TCP front-door config plus mTLS notes for tenant-only endpoints).

Couple of clarifying asks:
1) For the rotation trace, do you need console audit logs (human-readable) or the keyed event export (preferred: keyed event export CSV)?
2) Are you able to accept redacted operator identities (operator_id mapping file) or do auditors require full email addresses?

ETA: we will stage the Drive folder and send a link by Monday 10:00 AM PST. If audit needs are earlier, ping me and we'll accelerate.

Ben / Marissa — assigning you both to assemble artifacts. Keep the bundle compact: one CSV, one PDF, one text inventory, one runbook. Add checksums in the README.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@clearline.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Priya Mathur <priya.mathur@krypton-audit.com>, security@clearline.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM compact evidence ask for SIG+SOC2 review

On Sat, May 29, 2027 at 11:03 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Aaron / Priya,
> 
> Thanks — we can get that to you Monday, and I agree a compact bundle is the right approach. High-level plan:

Hi Aaron —

Bundle is ready for staging. Contents (summaries below) and attached files will be pushed to a shared Drive folder 'clearline-kms-compact-20270529' with a README and SHA256 checksums: 

1) rotation-trace-20270529.csv (CSV, 120 KB) — columns: key_id, old_key_fingerprint, new_key_fingerprint, rotate_timestamp, operator_id, rotation_cause. Operators are redacted to operator_###. This is an export of the keyed rotation events (not console screenshots) from our KMS.

2) hsm-attestation-202704.pdf (PDF, 540 KB) — vendor attestation signed 2027-04-12, includes FIPS 140-2 level assertions and vendor chain.

3) transit-cipher-inventory.txt (TXT, 6 KB) — list of TLS endpoints, accepted TLS versions, prioritized cipher suites, and comments about mTLS on tenant endpoints.

4) kms-runbook-compact.md (MD, 2.1 KB) — 1.5 page runbook excerpt: normal rotation, scheduled rollback, emergency-eviction procedure with contact matrix.

We've redacted operator emails per your preference. If auditors require the mapping to full emails, we will provide it under an MOU or redaction exception request.

Drive link (staged, view-only): https://drive.company.com/handshake/clearline-kms-2027 (will share with your security group and Priya).

If you prefer the bundle as a signed zip, say the word and we'll package with a detached PGP signature.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Security Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rotation-trace-20270529.csv (CSV), hsm-attestation-202704.pdf (PDF), transit-cipher-inventory.txt (TXT), kms-runbook-compact.md (MD)
